heading: INT. MOBILE DOG-GROOMING VAN - STUCK IN AUTOMATIC CAR WASH - DAY

units.text: INT. MOBILE DOG-GROOMING VAN - STUCK IN AUTOMATIC CAR WASH - DAY
Soap pours down the windshield in sheets.
Brushes thump on the roof.
Inside, a cramped cabin of clippers, towels, and a tiny steel tub where a very large poodle sits looking mortified.
GWENDOLYN "WENDY" OBUYA, forties, groomer, in a rubber apron, grips the steering wheel with both hands.
Beside her, TRISTAN FAIRCLOUGH, twenties, her apprentice, holds a phone to his ear.
Tell me they're turning it off.
units.name: WENDY

units.text: They're, um, looking at it.
units.name: TRISTAN

units.text: Sir, the system shows your vehicle as "paid but not exited." That's a process state.
units.name: LENNY

units.text: Can you turn the brushes off?
units.name: TRISTAN

units.text: That's a process state.
units.name: LENNY

units.text: What does that mean?
units.name: WENDY

units.text: It means you're in the process.
units.name: LENNY

units.text: Wendy closes her eyes.
The brushes thump louder.
The poodle whines.
It's okay, Duchess. It's okay.
units.name: TRISTAN

units.text: Don't talk to her. She knows we're lying.
units.name: WENDY

units.text: Sir, do you want the premium rinse? You're getting it anyway.
units.name: LENNY

units.text: Click.
The line dies.
The van lurches forward a foot and stops.
I swear to God.
units.name: WENDY

units.text: The side door slides open.
A man in a drenched uniform pushes in, one arm over his head against the spray: LEONARD "LENNY" BASKERVILLE, sixties, wearing a name badge that says MANAGER and a visible pool of soap in his hair.
Who's in charge of this vehicle?
units.name: LENNY

units.text: Me. Why are you in my van?
units.name: WENDY

units.text: Because it's in my wash.
units.name: LENNY

units.text: There's a dog in here, sir.
units.name: TRISTAN

units.text: I can see that. Is it licensed?
units.name: LENNY

units.text: For what?
units.name: WENDY

units.text: For the wash.
units.name: LENNY

units.text: The brushes thump.
The poodle sneezes a mouthful of foam.
Lenny looks at it, and the dog looks back.
Wendy takes her foot off the brake.
Hold on to something, Lenny.
units.name: WENDY

units.text: What?
units.name: LENNY

units.text: She guns the engine.
The van lurches, crunching through a plastic barrier, and bursts out the far end of the tunnel into daylight, trailing foam and a small yelp of triumph from Duchess.
I said thank you for choosing SparkleJet!
units.name: LENNY
